description: Save a question to the person's library; with `id`, replace that saved question. `question` is {text, answer_type: boolean|enum|numeric|date|text|place|list|relation, enum_values?, unit?, relation?, context?, temporal?, spatial?}. Questions are used by schemas (geothought_arrange_schema, geothought_draft_schema).
